format: outlines: {artworkId: {size: [w, h], paths: [[[x, y], ...], ...]}}. Pixel coordinates of Data/artwork/*.png (origin top-left, +y down). Each path is a closed loop (first point repeated last); loops are outer silhouettes or holes, filled even-odd. Silhouette = brightest colour channel >= 20 (the art has no alpha channel; Stellarium draws it additively) with regions smaller than 0.2% of the image removed/filled. Constellations without art (Pup, Vel, Ser) have no entry.
